574-678-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
574-678-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-678-4022.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

856-4321-5631-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5631-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3562-3817-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

622-757-5087-5101.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
622-757-5087-5101.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Merfolk Skydiver to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

654-4094-4365-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-4094-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1699-7839.description:
Activate Scourge of Kher Ridges by paying {5}{R}, dealing 6 damage to each other creature with flying.
Smaug triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}.
Repeat.

527-4067-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-4067-7890.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

913-1170-2440-7528.description:
Cast the copy of Awaken the Ages from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Strife Scholar, which enters prepared.
When Strife Scholar enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers for each of them, adding a total of at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {R} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding nine {C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 7 any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1978-5776-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1115-1563-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2173-5078-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
2173-5078-5796.description:
Activate Sense's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4659-5220-6594.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
4659-5220-6594.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1074-3525-4474.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

725-1336-2034-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
725-1336-2034-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

104-3197-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-4716.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

292-1495-1887.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-1887.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1495-3129-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Primal Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-3129-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

224-1772-2653-3257.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

511-817-3129-3921-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

586-2438-5258-5618-6121.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1308-4050-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1308-4050-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

645-914-2921-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-2921-3750.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

326-5194.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Dragonsguard Elite triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

578-2043-5295.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
578-2043-5295.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Metalworker that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Repeat using the Metalworker token instead.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

1335-2440-3519.manaNeeded: {R}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1335-2440-3519.description:
Cast Marath by paying {R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it for each mana spent to cast it.
When Marath enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental and/or Beast you control.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Repeat from step 3 until Marath has one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Marath, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Marath to the command zone from exile.
Activate Food Chain twice by exiling two Elemental tokens, adding {G}{W} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Marath for an arbitrarily large number of mana, and use its ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control and/or deal infinite damage to any target(s).

126-481-2647.notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
126-481-2647.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying {R}{R}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Warrior's Oath, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Warrior's Oath from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, Warrior's Oath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Obeka by tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the Warrior's Oath trigger from the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

2390-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the card's mana value.
All Will Be One triggers if counters were placed this way, as well as Phyrexian Devourer if its power is seven or greater.
Resolve the All Will Be One trigger, dealling one damage to an opponent for each counter placed this way.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

719-4050-4242-4640.notablePrerequisites:
Oathkeeper attached to Su-Chi.
Samurai chosen with Xenograft.
719-4050-4242-4640.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3272-3525-4474-4832.notablePrerequisites: Immovable Rod does not have summoning sickness.
3272-3525-4474-4832.description:
Cast Ensoul Artifact enchanting Immovable Rod.
Cast Pemmin's Aura enchanting Immovable Rod.
Activate Paradise Mantle by paying {1} to equip it to Immovable Rod.
Activate Immovable Rod by tapping it to add {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U} to untap Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

877-1099-1374-2452.description:
Sacrifice Morophon to Sling-Gang Lieutenant, losing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Cast Morophon from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
